A third distinct date, 2023-02-24, is when BASF announced the permanent closure of one Ludwigshafen ammonia plant alongside its FY2022 results. date_news_first_note: Approximately confirmed. The trawler collision was 2010-09-07; traders reported shipments suspended from about 2010-09-21; the New York Times broke the export-halt story on 2010-09-22, with CNBC following 2010-09-23 and France 24 2010-09-24. 2010-09-22 is defensible as first coverage of the export halt.
ground_truth_affected_note: No named company with a specific source stating a real impact, and TWO METHODOLOGICAL WARNINGS THAT MATTER MORE THAN THE EMPTY LIST. First, whether a targeted embargo occurred at all is contested in the scholarly literature: analysis of Japanese Ministry of Finance port-level customs data finds no uniform drop in Japanese imports of Chinese rare earths after the collision, and argues that any decline in H2 2010 is better explained by China's earlier decision to cut rare earth export quotas worldwide than by a Japan-specific embargo. If you keep this event, the ground truth is arguably 'contested' rather than empty, and it is a good adversarial case for a monitoring system that will happily find dozens of confident-sounding news assertions. Second, the graph candidate list is temporally invalid: CATL was founded in 2011, and Gotion, Sunwoda and CALB were not meaningful rare-earth consumers in 2010, yet all four sit in hop1. Any hop1 hit on those names is a guaranteed false positive. What is well documented is market-level: rare earth prices rose roughly tenfold in the year after the incident, Japan was about 90% dependent on Chinese supply, and Japan appropriated a JPY 100bn supplementary budget in October 2010 to reduce that dependence.

date_news_first_note: MOVED from the supplied 2020-01-01, which is the effective date rather than a news date. Indonesia announced the total nickel ore export ban on 2019-08-30, bringing it forward two years from the previously scheduled 2022; Argus reported it 2019-08-30 and your own seed source (Al Jazeera) is dated 2019-09-02. This is the same effective-date-versus-announcement-date pattern as the Section 232 row in batch 1: the market moved on the announcement, and LME nickel hit a five-year high in early September 2019, four months before the ban took effect.
ground_truth_affected_note: No named downstream company with a specific source stating a real impact. The documented effect is sector-level: Indonesia was shipping about 19.9 Mt/y of nickel ore to China to feed Chinese nickel pig iron smelters supplying the stainless steel industry, and Chinese nickel-in-NPI output was forecast to fall from about 490 kt to about 300 kt from 2021 onward. Tsingshan, the most-named Chinese producer, is documented as comparatively insulated rather than harmed, because it already operated a 3 Mt/y stainless mill plus nickel and chrome mines inside Indonesia. Of the eight hop1 candidates, POSCO, SeAH and SeAH Besteel are stainless and special-steel makers for whom the product logic is at least plausible, but no source ties any of them to an impact from this ban.
